system.description:
A Doused creature is covered in a toads belly oil, usually very flammable…oh no.

A Doused creature that takes Fire or Lightning damage takes 1d6 fire damage for each rank of Doused they have. Remove all ranks of Doused after this conditional damage is applied.

A Doused creature that takes Cold damage has its speed reduced by 10 feet for each rank of Doused they have and they cannot gain a bonus to speed, until the end of their next turn. Remove all ranks of Doused when this effect is applied.

A Doused creature can spend an Action, to make a DC 15 Dexterity ability check to end this affliction or submerge themselves fully into a body of water.
system.summary: Fire or lightning damage: +1d6 fire per rank, then it ends. Cold damage: −10 ft speed per rank. DC 15 Dexterity or submerging ends it.

rules.text: Fire or lightning damage: it takes 1d6 fire damage per rank, then loses all ranks. Cold damage: speed −10 ft per rank and no speed bonuses until the end of its next turn, then it loses all ranks. Submerging fully in water also ends it.
